items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide. Recommendation: block security-sensitive releases and new public exposure; conditionally allow ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but certificate and configuration coverage remain unverified. Compliance is 37 pass, 16 fail, and 8 unknown; analytics is unavailable for 38 expected sites. No active vulnerability or compromise is established. Risk severity is high evidence uncertainty, not a confirmed incident. Exact decision: continue existing bounded read-only evidence capture, preserve private launch gates, and issue no security-sensitive go-live approval or clean bill of health.

Retain existing security evidence work without creating duplicate telemetry or queue items. Required evidence remains: authentication and access boundaries; secret storage and exposure controls; runtime/container isolation; release and deployment approvals, rollback, and provenance; dependency and supply-chain inventory; TLS configuration coverage; data flows and exposure; monitoring and incident response signals; and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Ordinary growth may proceed only within existing consent, disclosure, data-handling, claims, and rollback boundaries.
